messages.content: You identify patterns in complete email texts. Respond with valid JSON.

Please write a BRIEF 15-20 word executive summary of the theme "Review and Decision-Making" as it appears in the following examples.
['As soon as you receive this mail you should contact me by return mail whether you are willing to enter into this deal.', 'I am now seeking your consent to present you as the next of kin/beneficiary to the deceased so that the proceeds of this account can be paid to you.', 'You are requested to communicate your acceptance or otherwise of this proposal to me, After which we shall discuss in details the modalities for seeing this transaction through.', 'Please if you are willing to partner with us, I will want you, to furnish us with your particulars, to enable, me give you further detail.', 'Please indicate your interest in working with me so that I can give you full details.', 'If you are still interested please config...', 'I will appreciate if you can get in touch with me bassoon as possible so that I can give you Reformation about my proposals.']

DO NOT write the summary as a third party using terms like "the text examples" or "they discuss", but write the summary from the perspective of the text authors making the points directly.
Please respond ONLY with a valid JSON in the following format:
{
    "summary": "<SUMMARY>"
}
